meta.name: setup
meta.description: Run initial NanoClaw setup. Use when user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw 的首次安装与配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接触 NanoClaw 需要初始化设置
copy.tagline_en: Complete initial setup and configuration of NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are new to NanoClaw and need to initialize it

howto.what: 当用户请求设置时,Claude 会指示你运行 `bash nanoclaw.sh`。该脚本自动处理依赖、容器镜像、OneCLI vault、Anthropic 凭据、服务、首个 agent 和可选渠道;中途出错会借助 Claude 辅助恢复并继续。
howto.when: 当你想安装、配置 NanoClaw 或进行首次设置,或说出 "setup"、"install"、"configure nanoclaw" 等触发词时,此技能会接管。

say.note: 开始设置流程,引导你执行脚本
直接触发该技能,Claude 会给出安装指引

howto.what_en: On setup requests, Claude tells the user to run `bash nanoclaw.sh`. The script handles dependencies, container, OneCLI vault, credentials, service, first agent, and optional channels; on error, it offers Claude-assisted recovery and resumes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to install or configure NanoClaw, do first-time setup, or say "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", etc.

say_en.note: Claude will tell you to run `bash nanoclaw.sh`
